state.invariant: Immutable narrative versions, completeness and approval against an exact source snapshot; approved content never mutates.
state.selected_replay_rule: Exact authorized retries resolve the original accepted result by CommandId and immutable intent digest, even after later facts. A changed intent under the same CommandId is refused. Expected revision is a concurrency precondition.

code_behavior.revise_on_approved: Revise on an approved description is refused with a Conflict error and appends no fact.
code_behavior.stale_revise: Revise with a new CommandId and an expected revision already advanced by another accepted revise is refused with Conflict and appends no fact.
code_behavior.retry_after_later_fact: Exact retry of an accepted revise (same CommandId, same request) after a further revise returns success and appends no fact; the same CommandId with a changed title is refused and appends no fact.
code_behavior.fact_payload: Each of the eight facts carries TenantId and SystemDescriptionId, which equal the stream address (tenant, system-descriptions, descriptionId), plus OccurredAt and ActorMemberId, which equal OperationProvenance.AcceptedAt and OperationProvenance.Actor.Id. Aggregate validation enforces the equality.

tests.t1: Seed draft (rev 1). Revise cmd A expected 1 -> rev 2. Revise cmd B expected 2 -> rev 3. Retry A succeeds; A with changed title fails; read shows rev 3, title of B, 3 facts total.
tests.t2: Seed draft. Revise cmd A expected 1 succeeds. Revise cmd C expected 1 fails Conflict. Read shows rev 2, title of A, 2 facts.
tests.t3: Seed approved description. Revise expected current revision fails Conflict; status stays approved, revision unchanged, fact count unchanged.

tests_assert_invariant.instructions: Taken together, `state.tests` t1, t2 and t3 assert the replay rule in `state.selected_replay_rule` and the invariant in `state.invariant` as behavior (events appended or not, state after read).

criteria.true: They assert the rule and invariant.
criteria.false: They only assert structure or miss part of it.

retry_after_later_fact.instructions: For `state.code_behavior.retry_after_later_fact`, which outcome is consistent with `state.selected_replay_rule`?

criteria.success_no_new_fact_changed_refused: Exact retry succeeds with no new fact; changed intent under the same CommandId is refused.
criteria.always_conflict_after_later_fact: Any retry after a later fact is a conflict.
criteria.retry_reapplies: The retry is applied again as a new fact.

payload_identity_duplication.instructions: Policy: payloads carry only business facts not already carried by stream identity or metadata. For `state.code_behavior.fact_payload`, what should be done for the duplicated fields?

criteria.remove_from_payload: Remove the duplicated identity/actor/time fields from the event payload in a later wire-versioned event change.
criteria.keep_as_is: Keep them; the duplication is a deliberate validated binding.
criteria.add_to_model: Register them in the catalog as business facts.

payload_premise.instructions: The payload fields TenantId, SystemDescriptionId, OccurredAt and ActorMemberId in `state.code_behavior.fact_payload` repeat stream identity or operation metadata.
